name: Point-based Isosurface Extraction with Octree Pruning
definition: A view-dependent algorithm that divides the model into grid cells until sub-pixel resolution is achieved, using point primitives to represent smaller triangles.
summary: Point-based Isosurface Extraction with Octree Pruning is a view-dependent method that recursively subdivides scalar fields into point primitives, using visibility and value-based pruning to efficiently render large unstructured grids on GPUs.
